comment: Hotline removed the CBM80 cartridge header, so RESET and RESTORE do not restart the game.
Hotline removed the CBM80 cartridge header, so RESET does not restart the game. Only RESET changes: the game sets the NMI vector to an RTI, so RESTORE did nothing before either.
Hotline trainer (key T in its menu): calls the trainer routine in place of sta $5d,x / dec $93,x.

Hotline trainer (key T in its menu): calls the trainer routine in place of sta $5d,x / dec $93,x. Fault: bmi apply_hit_damage_energy at $8877 goes to $8882, inside the JSR. The CPU runs DCP $d0ea, ORA $098a, NOP #$85 and LAX $9ba9 there. Thus no fighter loses energy while its hit animation runs, X becomes $bd, and $d0ea, $24 and $26 change.

code:
sta $5d,x
cpx #$00
beq +
dec $93,x
+
lda $93,x
rts
!byte $00
comment: Hotline trainer routine: fighter 0 (player 1) does not lose energy.
